proposal.reason: Primary change is in P2P IPC registration/connect flow to support multi-segment buffer export/import, segment-wise mapping, FD batch exchange, and deregistration semantics (`src/transport/p2p.cc`, `src/include/p2p.h`, `src/include/transport.h`). `memory` is independently substantive because shared HG/HGGC free/unmap helpers now enforce and execute segment-aware release behavior (`src/include/alloc.h`). `network` is also needed due to substantive proxy/FD lifecycle and connection-handle tracking changes in proxy IPC request handling and cleanup (`src/proxy.cc`, `src/include/proxy.h`, `src/include/ipcsocket.h`, `src/misc/ipcsocket.cc`).
